name: 7 routes registered
detail: router.go: 7 POST routes — create-from-checkout + cancel-on-checkout-failure (internalGroup); detail + list-mine + cancel-mine (customerGroup); list-admin + update-status-admin (adminGroup).

name: FULL: create-from-checkout
detail: 6-step tx: NextOrderNumber (global seq ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN) → INSERT orders (PENDING_PAYMENT v=0) → BulkInsert items (ORD-007 snapshots) → INSERT status_history (fromStatus=NULL SYSTEM) → COMMIT. No outbox on creation (correct).

name: FULL: detail
detail: ADMIN: GetByID → 404 on miss. CUSTOMER: GetByID → 404 ORDER_NOT_OWNED on miss or wrong owner (no existence leak). actorUserId suppressed for CUSTOMER (REV-L2-005). History sorted ASC.

name: FULL: list-mine
detail: Scoped to claims.Sub. Sort DESC created_at. page/limit server-enforced (default 20 max 100 min-page 1). Optional status filter. Returns orders+total+page.

name: FULL: payment.completed consumer
detail: Two-layer dedup: consumed_events PK InsertOrConflict (L1) + FOR UPDATE state-driven PENDING_PAYMENT guard (L2). UpdateStatus(PAID)+history in single tx. No outbox on PAID. Matches TD pseudocode.

name: FULL: cancel-on-checkout-failure (Wave B un-stubbed)
detail: 9-step tx: FOR UPDATE → idempotent no-op if CANCELLED → 409 if not PENDING_PAYMENT → ValidateTransition → UpdateStatus(CANCELLED) → INSERT history (SYSTEM checkout-failure) → INSERT outbox_events (order.cancelled AggregateID=orderId) → COMMIT.

name: STUB: cancel-mine + list-admin + update-status-admin
detail: All three return 501. cancel-mine TODO documents FOR UPDATE + ValidateTransition + outbox + idempotent re-cancel. Wave B scope.

name: STUB consumers: payment.failed + payment.expired + reservation.expired
detail: Three stubs return nil with slog TODO. All four consumers registered in RegisterConsumerRoutes keyed by event-name. Wave B scope.

name: State machine: 10 allowed transitions
detail: allowedTransitions map: PENDING_PAYMENT→{PAID PAYMENT_FAILED PAYMENT_EXPIRED CANCELLED×3} PAID→{PACKING CANCELLED} PACKING→SHIPPED SHIPPED→DELIVERED. Exactly 10 entries. Matches TD §state_machine.

name: State machine: 14 forbidden transitions covered
detail: TestValidateTransition_Forbidden: 4 terminal exits + 4 wrong-actor + 4 non-existent (from,to) + 2 self-transitions = 14. Terminal fast-path + implicit-deny cover all.

name: State machine: 27 tests per Dev report
detail: TestValidateTransition_Allowed 10 + TestValidateTransition_Forbidden 14 + TestIsTerminal 8 subtests + TestRequiredFieldsFor 2 assertions = 34 subtests / 4 test funcs. Dev report 27 = 10+14+3 helper-function count. No coverage gap.

name: INTERNAL_SHARED_SECRET: header constant
detail: const HeaderInternalSecret = X-Internal-Secret in middleware_internal_auth.go. Bound to internalGroup (both internal routes). Exposed in allowedHeaders() for CORS.

name: INTERNAL_SHARED_SECRET: constant-time compare
detail: crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(supplied), []byte(sharedSecret)) != 1. Returns 401 + c.Abort() on mismatch. Timing-oracle safe.

name: Outbox emit events.order.cancelled keyed by orderId
detail: cancel-on-checkout-failure: OutboxEvent.AggregateID=orderId EventType=order.cancelled payload={eventId occurredAt orderId cancelActor fromStatus reason}. Written in same tx as status UPDATE (ADR-004). cancel-mine + update-status-admin deferred to stub completion.
